ALL INVENTED TEST DATA. Synthetic candidate OBS-001; no real person, school, employer, contact details, repository or applicant is represented. Every project, competition, date and metric below is fictional fixture content, NOT actual achievements or release measurements.

Kept metric labels to service/route/status class rather than user IDs. Added request IDs to structured JSON logs and propagated OpenTelemetry trace context through HTTP calls. Wrote a Grafana dashboard and an error-budget-based alert with a runbook.
Invented test metrics: 48 pytest cases covering parser errors, retries, timeouts, duplicate samples and cancellation; 600 synthetic requests per second for 10 minutes; p95 instrumentation overhead of 3 milliseconds in one local fixture setup. These numbers are made up for testing interview answers, not real benchmark evidence.
Design and debugging: Compared histograms with summaries; used bounded queues and timeouts to avoid backlog. Investigated a fictional missing-metric incident by checking endpoint reachability, scrape labels, timestamps and container logs. Added readiness/liveness probes and graceful shutdown; rolled back a configuration error. Local single-node Kubernetes only, no production or multi-cluster claim.

Invented project B: StreamGauge Go log collector, 2026. Used a bounded worker pool, context cancellation, buffered channels and exponential-backoff retries to ship batched synthetic logs. Checked parser contracts with table-driven Go tests and the race detector. Wrote setup, contributor notes and a troubleshooting guide. Invented test metrics: 20 Go test cases and a 30-minute local soak with no detected race in that fixture. No real upstream contribution is claimed.

Invented competition: Fictional Student Telemetry Challenge, 2026. A fictional four-person team implemented a service-health dashboard; this candidate owned the exporter and failure-injection tests. Fictional result: second place among 12 fictional teams, using a rubric for debugging explanations and reproducibility. This competition and award do not exist.
